nodes.name: Burn
nodes.desc: A blend operation that darkens the foreground layer using the background. 1-(1-B)/F

nodes.name: Difference
nodes.desc: Outputs the distance between foreground and background values. abs(B-F)

nodes.name: Dodge
nodes.desc: A blend operation that lightens the background layer deperding on the foreground. B/(1-F)

nodes.name: Mix
nodes.desc: Mixes foreground and background inputs, weighting based on mix value. Lerp（F，B，m）= F * m + B(1 - m)

nodes.name: Over
nodes.desc: A merge operation that layers foreground over background, using the alpha of the foreground.

nodes.name: Overlay
nodes.desc: A blend operation that multiplies dark areas and screens light areas. 2 * F * B if F < 0.5; 1 - (1 - F)(1 - B) if F >= 0.5

nodes.name: Additive Mix
nodes.desc: Adds foreground and background values. B+F

nodes.name: Screen
nodes.desc: A blend operation that lightens areas that are darker than white. 1 - (1 - F)(1 - B)

nodes.name: Mask
nodes.desc: Outputs areas of background that overlap with the alpha of foreground.

nodes.name: Matte
nodes.desc: A merge operation that layers premultiplied foreground over background.

nodes.name: In
nodes.desc: Outputs areas of foreground that overlap with the alpha of background.

nodes.name: Out
nodes.desc: Outputs areas of foreground that do not overlap with background.

nodes.name: Inside
nodes.desc: Multiplies a mask to all channels of the input.

nodes.name: Outside
nodes.desc: Multiplies (1 - mask) to all channels of the input.

nodes.name: Disjoint Over
nodes.desc: A merge operation that layers foreground over background color, but assumes no overlap in partially transparent areas covered by both.

nodes.name: Subtractive Mix
nodes.desc: Subtracts foreground from background values. B-F

nodes.name: Premult
nodes.desc: multiply the RGB channels of the input by the Alpha channel of the input.

nodes.name: Unpremult
nodes.desc: divide the RGB channels of the input by the Alpha channel of the input.
